definitions.explanation: Working from one's home instead of commuting to an office.

examples.japanese: {週|しゅう}に3{日|にち}{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}している。
examples.english: I work from home three days a week.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}で{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}が{普及|ふきゅう}した。
examples.english: Work from home became widespread during the COVID-19 pandemic.

examples.japanese: {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}は{通勤時間|つうきんじかん}がなくて{楽|らく}だ。
examples.english: Working from home is nice because there's no commute time.

notes:
COMPONENTS:
{在宅|ざいたく} (being at home) + {勤務|きんむ} (work, duty)

SYNONYMS:
- リモートワーク: remote work (loanword)
- テレワーク: telework (loanword, common in Japan)
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク: work from home

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
While {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ} existed before 2020, it became much more common in Japan after the COVID-19 pandemic. Many Japanese companies now offer hybrid work arrangements.

RELATED TERMS:
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}: going to the office
- ハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ}: hybrid work
- フレックスタイム: flextime
- オンライン{会議|かいぎ}: online meeting

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}する: to work from home
- {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}{制度|せいど}: work from home system
- {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}{日|び}: work from home day
